finding_type: Uncapped Carrier Liability for Theft and Parcel Loss
summary: Party B bears all economic loss and liquidated damages arising from theft or disposal of stolen goods by its personnel, with no monetary cap or limitation of liability.
evidence_quote: Party B shall be responsible for all of Party A's economic loss and relevant liquidated damages arising out of any theft and disposal of stolen goods conducted by Party B's personnel.

summary: The agreement broadly assigns consequences and legal liability to Party B while expressly removing liability from Party A, creating a materially one-sided allocation of operational risk.
evidence_quote: Party B shall bear any consequences and legal liability arising out of Party B's non-compliance, and Party A shall have no liability.

finding_type: Unilateral Termination for Failure to Follow Party A's Directions
summary: Party A can terminate without further legal liability when Party B does not comply with Party A's management and arrangement, giving Party A a broad termination vector with no equivalent right for Party B.
evidence_quote: Party A has the right to terminate this Agreement without further legal liability in the case that Party B does not comply with Party A's management and arrangement.

finding_type: Early-Termination Trap and Additional Loss Exposure
summary: Party B cannot terminate early without Party A's written consent and may owe one month's freight plus unspecified additional losses, creating an asymmetric exit obligation.
evidence_quote: Party B shall obtain Party A's written consent in the case the early termination of the Agreement. Party B shall pay one-month freight as liquidated damages in case of termination of the Agreement without consent. Within the contract period, Party B shall not charge the freight difference if Party A rents same-level vehicles. Party B shall also compensate Party A's other losses.

summary: Any disagreement in interpretation is resolved by giving Party A final interpretive authority, creating a significant contractual imbalance.
evidence_quote: Any different interpretation of this Agreement by both Parties is subject to final interpretation by Party A.

finding_type: Unilateral Freight Determination and Settlement Ambiguity
summary: The settlement amount is based on EXW weight determined by Party A, giving one party control over a material pricing input and creating payment-dispute risk.

finding_type: Force Majeure Relief Subject to Party A Approval
summary: The force majeure procedure requires recording the event with Party A's approval, potentially making recognition of qualifying events dependent on the counterparty.
evidence_quote: In the special event of changes to route and time and severe weather (or other force majeure events), Party B shall be in touch with Party A in time and record such special event on the parcel transfer documents with Party A's approval.

finding_type: Broad Damage Compensation Standard Controlled by Party A
summary: Parcel damage caused by Party B's employees is compensated according to Party A's rules, while those rules are not defined in the agreement and no express liability cap is stated.
evidence_quote: Any parcel damage resulting from the fault of Party B's employees shall be compensated by Party B in accordance with Party A's relevant rules.

finding_type: Termination Without Compensation for Capacity Shortfall
summary: Party A may terminate without compensation if vehicle capacity is insufficient to satisfy its needs, placing capacity risk entirely on Party B.
evidence_quote: In the event the vehicle space insufficiency which causes Party A's need unable to be satisfied nor can it be adjusted to satisfy Party A's need, Party A can terminate this Agreement without any compensation.

finding_type: Potential Venue Ambiguity and Forum Friction
summary: Disputes are assigned to the People's Court where the agreement was signed, which may create uncertainty or inconvenience regarding the appropriate forum.
evidence_quote: Any dispute arising out of the execution of this Agreement, which cannot be negotiated and settled by both Parties, shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the People's Court where this Agreement is signed.
